WITH equipment_humidity AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity
  FROM equipment AS e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se
    ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
all_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS humidity_mean
  FROM equipment_humidity
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT eh.equipment_reference,
         eh.average_humidity,
         eh.average_humidity - aa.humidity_mean AS excess_over_all_average
  FROM equipment_humidity AS eh
  CROSS JOIN all_average AS aa
  WHERE eh.average_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND aa.humidity_mean IS NOT NULL
    AND eh.average_humidity > aa.humidity_mean
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS humidity_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT a.equipment_reference,
       a.average_humidity,
       a.excess_over_all_average,
       a.average_humidity - gm.humidity_mean AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average AS a
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS gm
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
